name: VGGSound: Large-Scale Audio-Visual Video Dataset
description: VGGSound is a large-scale audio-visual dataset containing 200,000 video clips (each 10 seconds long, totaling 550 hours) across 300 diverse sound categories collected from YouTube. Curated using automated visual and audio verification pipelines followed by human validation to ensure audio-visual correspondence (where the audio source is visually manifested within the video frame). Categories span human actions, animal vocalizations, musical instruments, vehicles, home appliances, and environmental sounds.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford
